reason: I already have my Toplux and reorder it when it runs out, and I don't take magnesium on its own. Another supplement from a brand I've never heard of isn't something I'd go out of my way to switch to.
objection: A named lab and a report sound good, but I've seen 'tested' claims before and can't tell a real report from marketing. Plus I'd be adding a new product when I already forget the ones on my counter.
would_change_my_mind: A creator I already follow showing the actual lab report for a batch and saying they use it daily, plus a cheap single-sachet trial pack so I'm not committing to a whole box.
